scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: All three candidates pass the frozen hard gates; candidate 03 is selected because it has the strongest frozen local-density score and the most source-like count, NND and Ripley balance while preserving the same coherent immune-region geometry.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 82,693-pixel joint change forms connected authorized stroma-to-immune regions; its 75,084-pixel tissue component remains above the significant hard floor and preserves adjacent non-target compartments.
decisions.nucleus_layout: The 82 class-2 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.875, 1.155, 0.943 and 1.042, the best overall balance among the three alternatives.
decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei remain inside authorized changed tissue; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density checks pass with score 0.898.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The target population has smaller nuclei and increased count relative to source, although within the frozen significant envelope. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity; two other targets for this patient abstained.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 03 as the single mask-condition handoff.
